Name: FigmaDeck
Author: PixelChew

Actions.Name: Property dial
Actions.Tooltip: Controls opacity, blur, radius, stroke or gap on the Figma selection, plus each one's mode. Needs the FigmaDeck plugin running in Figma.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Adjust value (spin fast for big steps)
TriggerDescription.Push: Click: cycle mode. Hold and turn: pick effect

Actions.Name: Focused field
Actions.Tooltip: Nudges whichever number field has focus in Figma's properties panel.

Actions.Name: Figma shortcut
Actions.Tooltip: Fires a Figma shortcut such as paste in place.

Description: Control Figma from the Stream Deck+ dials.
